moonshine-base.description: Sangat cepat, hanya bahasa Inggris. Mengenali aksen dengan baik.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Cepat, hanya bahasa Inggris. Keseimbangan yang baik antara kecepatan dan akurasi.

breeze-asr.description: Dioptimalkan untuk Mandarin Taiwan. Mendukung alih kode.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Pengenalan ucapan bahasa Rusia. Cepat dan akurat.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Sangat cepat. Bahasa Inggris, Jerman, Spanyol, dan Prancis. Mendukung penerjemahan.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Akurat dan multibahasa. Mendukung 25 bahasa Eropa serta penerjemahan.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: Model multibahasa yang besar dan lebih lambat, tetapi sangat akurat.

errors.requestFailed: Gagal meminta izin. Silakan coba lagi.

voice.description: Vox can read its replies aloud. The system voice works right away. The Natural and Phonon voices download once, to this computer. You can change this later on the Models page.

brain.title: Connect a language model (optional)
brain.description: Spoken replies can come from a language model. Ollama or LM Studio on this computer need no account. Nothing is sent until you run a test and choose to use it.
brain.consentLine: What you say, as text, is sent to {{destination}}.

transcribe.description: Pintasan keyboard untuk merekam dan mentranskripsikan suara Anda.

transcribe_with_post_process.description: Opsional: pintasan khusus yang selalu menerapkan pascaproses AI pada transkripsi Anda.

language.description: Pilih bahasa untuk pengenalan ucapan. Opsi Otomatis akan mendeteksi bahasa, sedangkan memilih bahasa tertentu dapat meningkatkan akurasi untuk bahasa tersebut.

shortcutActivation.title: Perilaku Pintasan
shortcutActivation.description: Pilih cara pintasan transkripsi memulai dan menghentikan perekaman.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Tahan untuk merekam atau tekan untuk mulai/berhenti
descriptions.toggle: Ketuk pintasan untuk mulai merekam, lalu ketuk lagi untuk berhenti

models.title: Model Transkripsi
models.description: Pilih model transkripsi atau unduh model tambahan. Setiap model menawarkan tingkat akurasi dan kecepatan yang berbeda.
models.deleteConfirm: Yakin ingin menghapus {{modelName}}? Anda harus mengunduhnya lagi untuk menggunakannya.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} adalah model aktif Anda. Menghapusnya akan menghentikan transkripsi sampai Anda memilih model baru. Yakin ingin melanjutkan?

filters.streaming: Saring model yang mendukung transkripsi waktu nyata
filters.translation: Saring model yang mendukung penerjemahan ke bahasa Inggris

rescan.label: Pindai Ulang
rescan.tooltip: Pindai ulang model yang ditambahkan ke folder model atau cache Hugging Face dari luar Vox

models.noModelsMatch: Tidak ada model yang cocok dengan kriteria ini.

finishSetup.title: Finish voice setup
finishSetup.description: Spoken replies and the Brain are not set up yet. Choose a voice and connect a language model to finish.

microphone.title: Mikrofon
microphone.description: Pilih perangkat mikrofon yang Anda inginkan

channel.title: Kanal Masukan
channel.description: Pilih kanal masukan yang akan direkam. Gunakan ini jika antarmuka audio Anda memiliki beberapa masukan.

audioFeedback.label: Umpan Balik Audio
audioFeedback.description: Putar suara saat perekaman dimulai dan dihentikan

outputDevice.title: Perangkat Keluaran
outputDevice.description: Pilih perangkat keluaran audio yang Anda inginkan untuk suara umpan balik

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Sesuaikan volume suara umpan balik audio

experimentalToggle.label: Fitur Eksperimental
experimentalToggle.description: Aktifkan fitur eksperimental yang masih dalam pengembangan.

memory.label: Memory
memory.description: Lets Vox remember facts you dictate (e.g. "remember that I prefer tea") in a local, offline database. Dictation is pasted as usual either way; remembered facts are only stored for future recall, never sent anywhere.
memory.empty: No facts remembered yet. Say "remember that..." while dictating, or add one above.

listeningMode.title: Listening Mode
listeningMode.description: Choose one way for Vox to listen without a hotkey: Wake Word listens only for a trigger phrase; Ambient Mode transcribes nearby audio into a short-lived, RAM-only buffer and acts only when addressed. Only one mode can be active at a time.

ambientMode.label: Ambient Mode
ambientMode.description: Continuously transcribes nearby audio into a short-lived, RAM-only buffer that is never written to disk. Vox acts only when it detects that you addressed your wake name (for example, "Vox, what time is it?").
ambientMode.disabledByWakeWord: Turn off Wake Word to enable Ambient Mode.
ambientMode.wakeNameDescription: Satu kata: huruf, angka, atau garis bawah. Berlaku setelah Vox dimulai ulang.
ambientMode.windowDescription: Seberapa banyak percakapan terbaru yang diingat mode ambien. Berlaku setelah Vox dimulai ulang.

wakeWord.confidenceDescription: Seberapa yakin detektor harus sebelum frasa pemicu memulai rekaman. Nilai lebih tinggi lebih ketat: lebih sedikit pemicu palsu, tetapi bisa melewatkan yang asli. Berlaku setelah Anda memulai ulang Vox.
wakeWord.cooldownDescription: Waktu tunggu setelah rekaman yang dimulai wake word sebelum mendengarkan lagi, dalam milidetik.
wakeWord.silenceTimeoutDescription: Mengakhiri rekaman yang dimulai wake word setelah senyap selama ini, dalam milidetik. Atur ke 0 untuk mematikan selesai otomatis.
wakeWord.label: Wake Word
wakeWord.description: Opt-in, continuous background listening for a wake phrase (currently "hey jarvis" as a placeholder -- a dedicated "Hey Vox" model is a future improvement). When enabled, saying the wake phrase auto-starts a normal dictation recording, same as pressing the hotkey. Mutually exclusive with actively using the hotkey at any given instant (whichever is active wins); both can be enabled as features at the same time.
wakeWord.disabledByAmbientMode: Turn off Ambient Mode to enable Wake Word.
wakeWord.downloadFailedTitle: Wake word model couldn't be downloaded

action.label: Saat saya mengucapkan kata pemicu
action.description: Pilih apakah kata pemicu menjalankan satu permintaan suara atau memulai percakapan lisan dengan asisten.

voiceCommands.label: Voice Commands
voiceCommands.description: Lets phrases like "open Safari" or "open Downloads" open the real app/folder instead of being pasted as text. Only recognized, deterministic commands run — anything else falls back to normal dictation.

voiceShortcuts.title: Voice Shortcuts
voiceShortcuts.description: Say a phrase exactly as written to run its action. Shortcuts work only while Voice Commands is on. Folder shortcuts open folders only, not files. App shortcuts require the app to be installed.
voiceShortcuts.empty: No shortcuts yet. Add one to map a spoken phrase to a URL, folder, or app.

voiceMediaControls.label: Media Controls
voiceMediaControls.description: Phrases like "pause", "next track" or "volume 40" control Spotify or Music and the system volume instead of being pasted. Only exact whole phrases are matched, but a standalone dictated "pause", "skip" or "mute" will be treated as a command while this is on. Requires Voice Commands. macOS may ask you to allow Automation the first time.

agentBridge.label: Agent Bridge
agentBridge.description: When a spoken command isn't recognized, send the transcript to a locally-configured CLI agent and show its reply as a suggestion. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you configure a binary below.
agentBridge.binaryPathDescription: Full path to the CLI agent executable to invoke. Leave empty to keep Agent Bridge inactive even if the toggle above is on.
agentBridge.promptFlagDescription: Flag yang meneruskan permintaan Anda ke perintah agen, misalnya -p. Harus berbeda dari flag agen.
agentBridge.mayHavePartlyRun: The agent may have partly run this request.

acpAgent.title: Agent (ACP)
acpAgent.description: Connects Vox to an agent program that speaks the Agent Client Protocol. Conversations and typed chat can hand work to it. Dictation is sent to it only if you also turn on Send dictation to the agent. Nothing starts unless you turn this on and set a program.
acpAgent.trustWarning: Trust warning: the agent program you configure is fully trusted and NOT sandboxed. It inherits Vox's environment and can use its own tools without asking Vox. While this is on, requests you hand over in conversations are sent to it, and so is dictation that no built-in command matched if you also turn on Send dictation to the agent. Denying permission requests does not limit the agent's own tools. Vox only strips terminal control characters from replies. It does not stop harmful instructions.

enabled.label: Use ACP agent
enabled.description: When on, conversations and typed chat can hand work to the agent program below. Dictation still pastes unless Send dictation to the agent is also on.

command.label: Agent program path
command.description: Absolute path to the agent program. Leave empty to turn the agent off. Vox does not search your PATH.

args.label: Agent arguments
args.description: Separated by spaces. No quotes or shell syntax. Up to 8 arguments, each up to 256 characters.

timeout.label: Turn timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for the agent to finish one reply. Between {{min}} and {{max}} seconds.

dictation.label: Send dictation to the agent
dictation.description: When off, dictation always pastes into the active window, even if the agent is on. When on, dictation that matches no voice command is sent to the agent instead of being pasted. Conversations and typed chat do not need this switch.

conversationHandoff.label: Hand open-ended requests to the agent in conversations
conversationHandoff.description: In Hey Jarvis conversations, requests that need the web, files or running programs are sent to your ACP agent. Local commands such as opening apps stay local.

errors.notAbsolute: Enter an absolute path, such as /path/to/my-agent. Relative paths and bare names are not allowed.
errors.tooLong: The path is too long. Use at most 1024 characters.
errors.controlChars: Remove control characters such as line breaks.
errors.argTooLong: Each argument must be at most 256 characters.
errors.outOfRange: Enter a number of seconds from 10 to 900.
errors.notInteger: Enter a whole number of seconds.

conversationPlanner.label: Plan multi-step requests
conversationPlanner.description: When on, a request with several steps is turned into a fixed plan that runs one step after another. Only works when hand-off to the agent is on.

stepAgents.title: Specialist agents (optional)
stepAgents.description: Use a different agent program for each kind of step. Leave a row blank to use the main agent above. General steps always use the main agent. Same rules as the main agent: an absolute path, and arguments separated by spaces.

browser.label: Browser steps
browser.description: Steps that open and read web pages.

code.label: Code steps
code.description: Steps that write or change code.

files.label: File steps
files.description: Steps that read or change files.

mode.label: Approval mode
mode.description: The agent reports what each tool call does, and Vox trusts that report. This is a convenience policy, not a sandbox. Use 'Ask before every tool call' for agents you do not fully trust. Earlier versions denied every request; this setting changes that behaviour.

options.ask_writes: Ask before changes (reads and searches run freely)

mode.allowAllWarning: The agent can edit, delete, run and browse without asking. Web pages and files it reads can steer it. Use Ask before changes if you do not fully trust the agent.

timeout.label: Approval timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for your answer before a request is denied ({{min}}-{{max}} seconds).

prompt.title: The agent wants to perform an action
prompt.detailsUnavailable: Operation details unavailable - the agent did not say what it will change.
prompt.untrustedNote: The agent describes this action itself. Vox does not check that description.

acpPermission.allowAllNotice: Vox is set to allow every agent action without asking. Change it in Settings > Agents.

agentContext.title: Conversation Context
agentContext.description: When on, your last few exchanges with the agent and any remembered facts are sent to the agent along with each request. The conversation is kept in memory only, and is cleared when you turn this off or restart Vox. A remembered fact or reply containing text that looks like instructions could influence the agent.
agentContext.clearFailedToast: Could not clear the conversation history.

tts.label: Spoken Replies
tts.description: Speaks agent replies and short confirmation or failure phrases aloud. Spoken output is audible to anyone nearby. Speech is paused while you are recording and never plays into your microphone on purpose.
tts.voiceDescription: Name of a system voice (for example "Samantha"). Leave empty to use the system default.
tts.voiceListDescription: Choose one of the voices installed on this Mac. Leave on System default to use the system voice.
tts.rateDescription: How fast spoken replies are read, in words per minute.
tts.testDescription: Speak a short sample with the current voice and rate.
tts.testPhrase: This is how spoken replies will sound.

composer.title: Spoken reply style
composer.description: Rewrites each agent reply into a short spoken sentence before Vox reads it aloud. Off speaks the reply text as it is.
composer.modeDescription: Off speaks replies as they are. Model asks a configured provider. Command runs a program you choose.
composer.providerDescription: Provider from your post-processing settings that writes the spoken sentence.
composer.providersLoadFailed: Could not load the provider list.
composer.modelDescription: Model name sent to the provider. Saved when you leave the field or press Enter.
composer.dataFlowModel: Sent to {{provider}} at {{baseUrl}}: the agent reply, the style text, and what you asked if that option is on.
composer.latencyModel: Model mode calls the provider directly and is usually much faster than command mode.
composer.commandPathDescription: Absolute path to a command-line agent program. Vox starts it for every reply.
composer.commandArgsDescription: Arguments placed before the prompt. Keep them free of secrets.
composer.promptFlagDescription: Flag that comes before the prompt text. Leave empty for -p.
composer.ackLabel: I understand the risks of running this command
composer.ackDescription: Required before command mode can run. Changing the path, the arguments or the flag asks for it again.
composer.ackWarning: Running this command executes a program with your user permissions every time Vox speaks a reply. The reply text and, if enabled, what you asked are passed to it as an argument. Text inside a reply could steer an agent into using tools or sending data, and Vox cannot enforce a tool-free mode. Prefer a configuration with no tools and no network access. Do not put secrets in the arguments: settings can appear in debug logs.

readiness.needs_acknowledgement: Needs your acknowledgement before it can run

composer.dataFlowCommand: Command: {{path}}. The reply text, and what you asked if that option is on, are passed to it as one argument.
composer.latencyCommand: Command mode starts a program for every reply. A reply usually takes 15 to 20 seconds.
composer.dataFlowUtterance: What you asked is sent along with each reply to the composer.
composer.styleDescription: Short instruction for how the spoken sentence should sound, for example: brief and friendly.
composer.timeoutDescription: How long to wait for the composer before speaking the fallback.
composer.timeoutRange: Enter a whole number of seconds from 2 to 60.
composer.sendUtteranceDescription: Also send your spoken request to the composer, so the sentence can answer it. Off sends only the agent reply and the style.
composer.fallbackDescription: What Vox speaks when the composer times out or fails.
composer.previewDescription: Compose a sample sentence with the current settings. Nothing is spoken.

status.not_configured: Not set up yet, spoke the fallback.
status.needs_acknowledgement: Command not acknowledged, spoke the fallback.
status.backend_error: The composer failed, spoke the fallback.
status.output_too_large: The composer reply was too long, spoke the fallback.
status.empty: The composer returned nothing, spoke the fallback.
status.unparseable: The composer reply could not be read, spoke the fallback.
status.superseded: A newer reply replaced this one.

voice.label: Suara alami
voice.description: Pilih suara yang digunakan untuk ucapan alami.

model.label: Model suara alami
model.notInstalled: Belum diunduh. Unduhan satu kali sekitar {{size}}; ucapan dibuat di perangkat ini dan teks Anda tidak pernah dikirim ke mana pun.
model.needed: Unduh model untuk menggunakan suara alami. Sampai saat itu, suara sistem digunakan.

failure.banner: Suara alami berhenti berfungsi, jadi suara sistem digunakan.
failure.sink: Keluaran audio gagal. Periksa perangkat keluaran Anda.
failure.worker_exit: Mesin ucapan berhenti secara tak terduga.

notice.firstSpeech: Kalimat pertama dapat memerlukan beberapa detik saat model dimuat.
notice.limitations: Hanya bahasa Inggris. Kalimat dalam aksara lain diucapkan oleh suara sistem.

engines.fixedNote: Semua suara berjalan di perangkat ini. Model hanya diunduh sekali, dan hanya jika Anda memilihnya.

phonon.name: Phonon
phonon.description: Suara bahasa Inggris yang alami, sepenuhnya berjalan di komputer Anda.
phonon.help: Phonon berbicara dalam bahasa Inggris; balasan yang tidak terdengar seperti bahasa Inggris menggunakan suara sistem. Deteksinya bersifat perkiraan.
phonon.license: Model suara: {{license}}. Jangan gunakan untuk meniru orang sungguhan tanpa persetujuannya.
phonon.fixedVoiceRate: Phonon menggunakan satu suara bawaan dan kecepatan bicara yang tetap.

model.label: Model suara Phonon
model.description: Unduhan sekali saja sekitar {{size}}, diperiksa dengan checksum tetap. Ucapan dibuat di perangkat ini.

engines.confirmDelete: Hapus model suara Phonon? Anda dapat memasangnya lagi nanti.

error.corrupt: File suara tidak lolos verifikasi. Pasang ulang suara.
error.disk: File suara tidak dapat ditulis. Periksa ruang kosong di disk.
error.blocked: Alamat unduhan ini tidak diizinkan. Pasang suara dari folder sebagai gantinya.
error.generic: Suara tidak dapat dipasang. Coba lagi.
error.proxy: Unduhan diblokir oleh proxy jaringan yang memerlukan masuk.

engines.importHint: Anda juga dapat memasang dari folder yang berisi empat file model.
engines.proxyHint: Diblokir oleh proxy? Unduh empat file dari tempat lain dan pasang dari folder.
engines.unsupportedSelected: Tidak tersedia di platform ini. Suara sistem digunakan sebagai gantinya.

lazyStreamClose.label: Biarkan Mikrofon Tetap Aktif di Antara Transkripsi
lazyStreamClose.description: Membiarkan aliran mikrofon tetap terbuka selama 30 detik setelah perekaman berhenti untuk mengurangi latensi pada transkripsi beruntun. Dapat menurunkan kualitas audio Bluetooth saat aktif.

transcribe.title: Akselerasi transcribe.cpp
transcribe.description: Akselerasi perangkat keras untuk model transcribe.cpp (keluarga Whisper). Otomatis menggunakan GPU jika tersedia (Metal di macOS, Vulkan di Windows/Linux).

ort.title: Akselerasi ONNX
ort.description: Akselerasi perangkat keras untuk model ONNX (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, dll.). DirectML di Windows bersifat eksperimental. Model mungkin gagal mentranskripsikan.

startHidden.label: Mulai dalam Keadaan Tersembunyi
startHidden.description: Jalankan ke baki sistem tanpa membuka jendela.

autostart.label: Jalankan saat Komputer Dinyalakan
autostart.description: Mulai Vox secara otomatis saat Anda masuk ke komputer.

showTrayIcon.label: Tampilkan Ikon Baki Sistem
showTrayIcon.description: Tampilkan ikon Vox di baki sistem.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Pilih overlay perekaman: Tidak Ada menyembunyikannya, Minimal menampilkan indikator ringkas, dan Langsung menampilkan transkripsi secara waktu nyata saat Anda berbicara (hanya model yang mendukung streaming — cari lencana Streaming di pemilih model). Di Linux, 'Tidak Ada' direkomendasikan.

position.title: Posisi Overlay
position.description: Lokasi overlay muncul di layar selama perekaman dan transkripsi.

pasteMethod.title: Metode Tempel
pasteMethod.description: Pilih cara teks dimasukkan. Langsung: mensimulasikan pengetikan melalui masukan sistem. Tidak Ada: melewati proses tempel dan hanya memperbarui riwayat/papan klip.

typingTool.title: Alat Pengetikan
typingTool.description: Pilih alat pengetikan Linux yang digunakan untuk metode tempel Langsung. Otomatis akan mendeteksi dan menggunakan alat terbaik yang tersedia untuk sistem Anda.

clipboardHandling.title: Penanganan Papan Klip
clipboardHandling.description: Jangan Ubah Papan Klip akan mempertahankan isi papan klip saat ini setelah transkripsi. Salin ke Papan Klip akan membiarkan hasil transkripsi tetap berada di papan klip setelah ditempel.

autoSubmit.title: Kirim Otomatis
autoSubmit.description: Kirim kombinasi tombol yang dipilih secara otomatis setelah teks dimasukkan. Cmd+Enter berlaku di macOS, sedangkan Windows/Linux menggunakan Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Terjemahkan ke Bahasa Inggris
translateToEnglish.description: Terjemahkan ucapan dari bahasa lain ke bahasa Inggris secara otomatis selama transkripsi.

modelUnload.title: Keluarkan Model dari Memori
modelUnload.description: Bebaskan memori GPU/CPU secara otomatis jika model tidak digunakan selama waktu yang ditentukan

customWords.title: Kata Khusus
customWords.description: Bantu model yang didukung mengenali nama dan istilah khusus. Koreksi fuzzy saat ini terbatas pada kata yang menggunakan huruf A–Z dan angka.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Deteksi Aktivitas Suara
voiceActivityDetection.description: Saring keheningan dari rekaman. Model yang mendukung streaming menggunakan ekor VAD yang lebih panjang; menonaktifkan VAD akan merekam audio mentah.

vadBackend.title: Backend Deteksi Aktivitas Suara
vadBackend.description: Pilih detektor yang digunakan untuk menyaring keheningan. Earshot bersifat eksperimental; kembali ke Silero jika ucapan terpotong atau kebisingan tetap terekam.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Hapus Kata Pengisi
fillerWordRemoval.description: Menghapus kata pengisi umum dari transkripsi. Nonaktifkan untuk mempertahankannya.
fillerWordRemoval.customHelp: Pisahkan kata dengan koma atau baris baru. Hingga 100 kata, masing-masing paling banyak 32 karakter. Pencocokan tidak membedakan huruf besar dan kecil.
fillerWordRemoval.customTooMany: Daftar kustom dapat berisi paling banyak {{max}} kata.
fillerWordRemoval.customTooLong: Setiap kata dapat berisi paling banyak {{max}} karakter.
fillerWordRemoval.customEmpty: Tambahkan minimal satu kata, atau pilih Daftar bawaan atau Nonaktif.

chineseScript.title: Aksara Tionghoa
chineseScript.description: Menulis transkripsi Mandarin dan Kanton dengan aksara Sederhana atau Tradisional. Bahasa lain tidak diubah.

provider.title: Penyedia
provider.description: Pilih penyedia yang kompatibel dengan OpenAI.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence tidak tersedia di perangkat ini. Memerlukan Mac Apple Silicon yang menjalankan macOS Tahoe (26.0) atau yang lebih baru dengan Apple Intelligence diaktifkan di Pengaturan Sistem.

baseUrl.title: URL Dasar
baseUrl.description: URL dasar API untuk penyedia yang dipilih. Hanya penyedia kustom yang dapat diedit.

apiKey.title: Kunci API
apiKey.description: Kunci API untuk penyedia yang dipilih.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Masukkan pengenal model yang diharapkan oleh endpoint kustom Anda.
model.descriptionDefault: Pilih model yang disediakan oleh penyedia yang dipilih.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Prompt Terpilih
selectedPrompt.description: Pilih templat untuk menyempurnakan transkripsi atau buat yang baru. Gunakan ${output} dalam teks prompt untuk merujuk ke hasil transkripsi.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Tulis instruksi yang dijalankan setelah transkripsi. Contoh: Perbaiki tata bahasa dan kejelasan teks berikut: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tips: Gunakan ${output} untuk menyisipkan teks hasil transkripsi ke prompt Anda.
prompts.selectToEdit: Pilih prompt di atas untuk melihat dan mengedit detailnya.
prompts.createFirst: Klik 'Buat Prompt Baru' di atas untuk membuat prompt pascaproses pertama Anda.

history.title: Riwayat
history.empty: Belum ada transkripsi. Mulai merekam untuk mengisi riwayat Anda!
history.searchError: Failed to search history. Please try again.
history.copyError: Gagal menyalin transkripsi ke papan klip.
history.deleteError: Gagal menghapus entri. Silakan coba lagi.
history.retranscribeError: Gagal mentranskripsikan ulang. Silakan coba lagi.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transkripsi gagal. Anda dapat mentranskripsikan ulang menggunakan ikon coba lagi.

liveLogs.title: Log Waktu Nyata
liveLogs.description: Tampilkan log aplikasi secara waktu nyata untuk mendiagnosis masalah tanpa membuka file log. Hanya log yang dihasilkan saat panel ini terbuka yang ditampilkan; mengikuti pengaturan Tingkat Log di atas.
liveLogs.empty: Menunggu log… Entri akan muncul di sini saat aplikasi menghasilkannya.

updateChecks.label: Periksa Pembaruan
updateChecks.description: Periksa versi baru Vox secara otomatis

whatsNewPreview.title: Pratinjau Yang Baru
whatsNewPreview.description: Buka catatan rilis terbaru yang disertakan tanpa menandainya sebagai telah dilihat
whatsNewPreview.noNotes: Tidak ada catatan rilis yang disertakan

onboardingPreview.title: Pratinjau Penyiapan Awal
onboardingPreview.description: Pratinjau layar penyiapan awal tanpa mengubah izin, model, atau status penyelesaian

soundTheme.label: Tema Suara
soundTheme.description: Pilih tema suara untuk umpan balik saat perekaman dimulai dan dihentikan

historyLimit.title: Batas Riwayat
historyLimit.description: Jumlah maksimum entri riwayat yang disimpan

recordingRetention.title: Hapus Rekaman Secara Otomatis
recordingRetention.description: Hapus rekaman lama secara otomatis untuk menghemat ruang

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Mikrofon Selalu Aktif
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Biarkan mikrofon aktif agar respons lebih cepat

clamshellMicrophone.title: Mikrofon Saat Laptop Ditutup
clamshellMicrophone.description: Mikrofon yang digunakan saat laptop ditutup

postProcessingToggle.label: Pascaproses
postProcessingToggle.description: Aktifkan penyempurnaan teks berbasis AI setelah transkripsi

keyboardImplementation.title: Implementasi Keyboard
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Pintasan keyboard tidak kompatibel dan telah dikembalikan ke nilai awal

pasteDelay.title: Jeda Tempel (Sebelum)
pasteDelay.description: Jeda (dalam milidetik) setelah menyalin teks sebelum mengirim perintah tempel. Tingkatkan jika tidak ada yang ditempel.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Jeda Tempel (Sesudah)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Jeda (dalam milidetik) setelah perintah tempel dikirim sebelum mengembalikan isi papan klip sebelumnya. Tingkatkan jika isi papan klip lama yang ditempel alih-alih transkripsi.

holdThreshold.title: Ambang Waktu Tahan
holdThreshold.description: Hanya mode Otomatis: berapa lama (dalam milidetik) pintasan harus ditahan agar dianggap ditahan, bukan ditekan singkat. Turunkan jika penahanan singkat membuat perekaman tetap aktif; naikkan jika ketukan yang disengaja dianggap sebagai penahanan.

reliablePaste.title: Tempel Lebih Andal (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Kembalikan papan klip hanya setelah aplikasi target benar-benar membaca transkripsi, bukan setelah jeda tetap. Ditujukan untuk memperbaiki kasus isi papan klip lama yang tertempel saat sistem sedang terbebani. Memerlukan metode tempel papan klip; hanya macOS dan Windows.

recordingBuffer.title: Buffer Perekaman Tambahan
recordingBuffer.description: Waktu tambahan (dalam milidetik) untuk terus merekam setelah Anda melepas tombol agar audio di bagian akhir tetap tertangkap. 0 = tanpa buffer tambahan.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Diagnostik Keyboard
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Memeriksa apakah peristiwa keyboard mencapai Vox. Hanya jumlah peristiwa yang dicatat — bukan tombol yang Anda tekan.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Mendengarkan… tekan pintasan Anda beberapa kali (mis. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.holderUnknown: tidak ada aplikasi penahan yang terdeteksi
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input memblokir peristiwa tombol — pintasan keyboard tidak dapat berfungsi sampai masalah ini diselesaikan.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Peristiwa tombol pengubah diterima, tetapi tidak ada peristiwa tombol — sesuatu memblokir input tombol meskipun Secure Input dilaporkan nonaktif. Harap laporkan ini di GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Peristiwa tombol mencapai Vox secara normal.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: Tidak ada peristiwa yang tertangkap — apakah Anda menekan tombol selama pengujian?

whatsNewUpdates.label: Tampilkan Yang Baru
whatsNewUpdates.description: Tampilkan catatan rilis setelah Vox diperbarui

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: Pustaka tensor berkinerja tinggi untuk inferensi pembelajaran mesin di perangkat
ggml.details: Fitur ucapan-ke-teks lokal Vox dibangun menggunakan transcribe.cpp dan ggml. Terima kasih kepada Georgi Gerganov dan para kontributor atas karya luar biasa mereka.

acpAgent.groupDescription: An agent program you choose that conversations and typed chat can hand work to. Dictation goes to it only if you turn on Send dictation to the agent. The program is fully trusted and not sandboxed.

realtime.title: Realtime conversation
realtime.intro: Experimental. Every behaviour below is off until you turn it on. Nothing is sent to a remote endpoint unless you enable "Use my own endpoint".

enabled.label: Enable realtime conversation
enabled.description: Turns on the realtime conversation behaviour. When off, the conversation works exactly as before.

speakReplies.label: Speak replies aloud
speakReplies.description: Speaks the conversation's replies out loud. This is the same setting as Spoken Replies.

directEndpoint.label: Use my own endpoint
directEndpoint.description: Send replies to the endpoint you enter below instead of the speech composer settings.

endpoint.label: Endpoint address
endpoint.description: Base address of an Anthropic-style API. Must use https unless it is localhost.

model.label: Model name
model.description: Name of the model to ask.

token.label: Access token
token.description: Pasted by you and stored in Vox settings. It is never shown here and never written to logs.

status.off: Off: turn on the realtime conversation and your own endpoint to use it.
status.ok: Ready: the endpoint, model and token are set.
status.invalid_endpoint: The endpoint address is not valid.
status.needs_https: The endpoint must use https unless it is localhost.

errors.needs_https: Use https for this address (plain http is allowed only for localhost).

streamReply.label: Stream replies
streamReply.description: Show and speak the reply as it is generated instead of waiting for the whole answer.

earlySpeech.label: Speak while the reply streams
earlySpeech.description: Start speaking sentences before the reply finishes. Needs Stream replies.

fastVoice.label: Fast voice engine
fastVoice.description: Use a resident system voice for lower speaking delay (macOS).

ack.label: Spoken acknowledgement
ack.description: Say a short "One moment" when the reply is slow.

prewarm.label: Pre-connect
prewarm.description: Open the connection to the endpoint before your first question.

autoProxy.label: Auto-detect proxy
autoProxy.description: Use the proxy from your environment or login shell when Vox is started from Finder.

proxy.label: Use a manual proxy
proxy.description: Route realtime requests through the proxy address below.

proxyUrl.label: Proxy address
proxyUrl.description: http or https address of the proxy, with a host and port.

timingLog.label: Timing log
timingLog.description: Log per-turn latency numbers only. No text or tokens are logged.

conversationMemory.recordsDescription: Saves a local record of your voice conversations so you can look back at them later. Off by default; nothing is saved unless you turn this on. Redaction of sensitive text is best-effort, so review what is saved. Conversation summaries are generated with the model endpoint your conversation already uses.
conversationMemory.vaultToggleLabel: Also save to my notes vault
conversationMemory.vaultToggleDescription: Also writes each saved conversation as a Markdown note in the vault folder below. Needs Save conversation records on and a vault folder set.
conversationMemory.vaultPathDescription: Full path to the folder inside your notes vault where conversation notes are written. Leave empty to turn off vault saving.
conversationMemory.contextLabel: Use my vault notes as conversation context
conversationMemory.contextDescription: While this is on, the conversation is answer-only: it cannot paste text or open things, and replies start slightly slower, until a confirmation feature exists. Command and agent-bridge backends do not get vault context or model summaries.
conversationMemory.groupDescription: Opt-in records of your conversations, with optional vault notes and vault context.

vaultRag.title: Pencarian di catatan brankas
vaultRag.description: Memungkinkan asisten suara menemukan bagian catatan yang relevan di brankas Anda dan menggunakannya untuk menjawab. Mati secara default.

enable.label: Cari di catatan brankas saya
enable.description: Membuat indeks kata kunci lokal untuk folder di bawah. Saat Anda mengajukan pertanyaan, bagian yang cocok dikirim ke penyedia model Anda. Memerlukan folder brankas dan rute model waktu nyata.

vaultRag.needsVaultPath: Atur dulu folder brankas di Memori percakapan.

folders.label: Folder brankas yang diindeks
folders.description: Nama folder di dalam brankas, dipisahkan koma. Hanya nama sederhana: tanpa garis miring, tanpa "..", dan tanpa titik di awal. Maksimal 16 folder.

status.unavailable: Tidak tersedia. Coba indeks ulang atau periksa folder brankas.
status.busy: Sibuk. Indeks sedang dipakai; coba lagi sebentar lagi.
status.counts: {{notes}} catatan, {{chunks}} bagian yang bisa dicari, {{skipped}} dilewati

results.supported: Dukungan alat: berfungsi pada rute model saat ini.
results.unsupported: Dukungan alat: tidak tersedia. Sesi brankas hanya memakai bukti, tanpa alat.
results.unknown: Dukungan alat: hasil uji tidak jelas.

disclosure.folders: Pencarian catatan brankas hanya membaca folder yang tercantum dan tidak mengirim apa pun saat mati. Sakelar konteks brankas yang terpisah memiliki perilakunya sendiri.
disclosure.sentToProvider: Pertanyaan Anda, giliran bicara terbaru, cuplikan catatan yang cocok, argumen alat, dan hasil alat dikirim ke penyedia model yang dikonfigurasi.
disclosure.bestEffortRedaction: Penyembunyian rahasia di catatan dilakukan sebisanya. Sebagian bisa terlewat, jadi jangan hanya mengandalkannya.
disclosure.notesMayInstruct: Catatan dapat berisi instruksi yang mungkin diulang model dalam jawabannya. Karena itu sesi brankas hanya untuk menjawab: tidak bisa menempelkan teks atau membuka apa pun.
disclosure.spokenAloud: Jawaban diucapkan dengan keras, jadi orang di sekitar dapat mendengar isi catatan.
disclosure.toolsRequirement: Alat brankas hanya baca. Alat hanya berjalan jika alat agen aktif dan rute model langsung digunakan.
disclosure.unsupportedFallback: Jika uji alat menyatakan alat tidak didukung, sesi brankas pada rute itu beralih ke bukti saja, tanpa alat.
disclosure.localCache: Indeks adalah file cache lokal di folder data aplikasi. Anda bisa menghapusnya kapan saja; menghapusnya tidak mengubah catatan Anda.

agentTools.groupDescription: Let the voice assistant read project status and files. Off by default.
agentTools.enabledDescription: Lets the voice assistant read git status, file contents, project names and recent conversations to answer questions. Off by default.
agentTools.guardLabel: Block actions after reading project data
agentTools.guardDescription: Protects against files or web text that try to trick the assistant into pasting or opening things. Turn off to let the assistant act freely. When off, a malicious file you ask about could cause it to paste text or open a link.
agentTools.projectRootsDescription: Folders the assistant may read. Type an absolute path and press Add folder.
agentTools.noProjectRoots: No project folders yet. The assistant cannot read any project until you add one.
agentTools.projectRootsLimit: You can add up to {{max}} project folders.
agentTools.privacyText: When tools are on, file contents and git status are sent to the model. Redaction of sensitive text is best-effort, so review what your project folders contain.

jobs.groupDescription: Let the voice assistant start a coding job in a project folder. Off by default.
jobs.confirmDescription: Vox asks "OK?" aloud before it types, opens something or starts a coding job. Turn off only if you trust every voice command.
jobs.enabledDescription: Lets the voice assistant start your coding CLI on a task inside a project folder you configured. Off by default.
jobs.timeoutDescription: A job is stopped when it runs longer than this. Choose from {{min}} to {{max}} minutes.
jobs.warning: A coding job runs your coding CLI with your account's permissions and environment inside the project folder. The task text is visible to other programs on this computer while it runs.

agents.label: Agent names
agents.description: Names of the coding agents Vox may choose from. Leave empty to always use the default agent.
agents.invalid: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
agents.limit: You can add up to {{max}} agent names.

flag.label: Agent flag
flag.description: The option that passes the chosen agent name to the coding CLI, for example --agent.
flag.invalid: Use one or two dashes, then a letter and up to 31 more letters, digits or dashes. It cannot be the prompt flag.

ask.label: Ask an agent and speak a summary
ask.description: After an ask job finishes, Vox sends a redacted excerpt (at most 8 KiB) of the agent's output to the model gateway you configured and speaks a short summary. Off by default.

search.label: Cari pengaturan
search.noResults: Tidak ada pengaturan yang ditemukan untuk “{{query}}”

chatLog.title: Keep conversation transcript
chatLog.description: Keep a live transcript of the conversation in memory for the conversation window. It is never saved to disk.

chatOpenOnStart.label: Open the conversation window when a conversation starts
chatOpenOnStart.description: Say "Hey Jarvis" and the conversation window appears by itself, without taking keyboard focus. Needs the transcript to be kept.

brain.description: One language-model connection that Reply style, Real-time conversation and Post Process can share. Vox sends nothing to it unless you allow a feature to use it.

providers.custom: Custom (Ollama, LM Studio or another server)

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Pick a service, or Custom for Ollama, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server.

baseUrl.title: Endpoint address
baseUrl.description: https:// for any host, or http:// only for this computer (localhost).

quickFill.title: Quick setup
quickFill.description: Fill in the address of a server running on this computer.

urlError.invalid: The endpoint address is not a valid URL.
urlError.scheme: The endpoint must start with https://, or http:// for this computer.
urlError.userinfo: Remove the user name and password from the endpoint address.
urlError.plainHttp: Plain http is only allowed for this computer (localhost). Use https for other hosts.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Needed for a remote endpoint. Stored on this computer and never shown again.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model the endpoint should use. Fetch models lists what the endpoint offers.

test.title: Test connection
test.description: Checks the endpoint with one fixed message. Nothing you have said is sent.
test.ack: I understand that Test sends the fixed message "{{prompt}}" to {{destination}}, with the saved access token if one is set. Nothing you have said is sent.
test.not_found: The endpoint address or path was not found.
test.redirect: The endpoint redirected the request, which Vox does not follow.
test.bad_response: The endpoint answered with something unexpected.
test.invalid_url: The endpoint address is not allowed (use https, or http for this computer only).

feature.title: Features
feature.description: For each feature, choose whether it uses the Brain or its own setup.

state.needs_consent: Needs your permission to use the Brain

consent.title: Let {{feature}} send what you say to the Brain?
consent.body: What you say, as text, is sent to the Brain endpoint by this feature. You can switch back to its own setup at any time.

notice.needsSetup: {{feature}} needs the Brain, which is not set up yet.
notice.needsConsent: {{feature}} needs your permission to send what you say to the Brain.

errors.save: Could not save the Brain settings.
errors.token: Could not save the access token.
errors.clear: Could not clear the access token.
errors.test: The connection test could not run.
errors.models: Could not fetch the models from the endpoint.
errors.feature: Could not change this feature's setup.

floatingOrb.title: Floating orb
floatingOrb.description: A small orb that stays on top of other apps. Click it to open the conversation.

show.title: Show orb
show.description: Keep the orb on screen above other apps. You can also use the tray menu.

resetPosition.title: Reset orb position
resetPosition.description: Move the orb back to its default corner.

reason.wayland: Floating windows are not available on Wayland. Vox uses the classic window.
reason.unknown_backend: This display system is not recognised, so the orb is unavailable.
reason.no_compositor: The orb needs a compositing desktop, which is not running.
reason.unsupported_os: The orb is not available on this operating system.
reason.unknown: The orb is not available on this system.

surface.title: When I talk to Vox
surface.description: Choose what appears when a conversation starts.

hints.chatLogOff: Bubbles need the conversation log, which is turned off.
hints.wakeDictation: Hey Jarvis currently starts dictation, so no bubbles appear. Switch it to start a conversation.
hints.wakeButton: Make Hey Jarvis start a conversation

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Instalasi portabel tidak dapat diperbarui secara otomatis. Unduh penginstal untuk sistem Anda di bawah ini, jalankan, lalu instal ke folder yang sama — folder Data/ Anda (pengaturan, model, rekaman) tetap dipertahankan.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Instalasi portabel tidak dapat diperbarui secara otomatis. Unduh versi terbaru untuk sistem Anda dari GitHub Releases dan instal ke folder yang sama — folder Data/ Anda (pengaturan, model, rekaman) tetap dipertahankan.

dialog.title: Update Vox
dialog.explanation: Updating builds the latest code from GitHub main in your local checkout using the repository's own update script. A Terminal window opens, the build takes several minutes, and Vox restarts when it finishes.
dialog.blockerUnknown: Could not verify that the checkout is ready to update.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Vox memerlukan izin aksesibilitas untuk mengetik teks hasil transkripsi.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Akses mikrofon ditolak oleh sistem operasi. Berikan izin mikrofon di pengaturan sistem Anda.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Aktifkan akses mikrofon di Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (termasuk akses aplikasi desktop).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Berikan akses mikrofon di System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Berikan akses mikrofon di pengaturan suara atau privasi sistem Anda.

errors.noInputDevice: Tidak ada perangkat masukan audio yang terdeteksi. Hubungkan mikrofon atau headset lalu coba lagi.
errors.conversationActive: A conversation is using the microphone. Finish or stop it before dictating.
errors.pasteFailed: Teks tidak dapat ditempelkan ke aplikasi aktif.

theme.title: Tema Aplikasi
theme.description: Pilih apakah Vox mengikuti tema sistem atau selalu menggunakan tema terang atau gelap

custom.description: Pick any color for each part of the interface

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS untuk sementara memblokir perubahan pintasan
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Pintasan tidak dapat direkam saat ini — macOS Secure Input memblokir peristiwa tombol. Selesaikan peringatan Secure Input terlebih dahulu.

end.idle: Stopped after no speech for several turns.
end.not_configured: Spoken replies are not set up. Turn on spoken replies and choose a reply backend.
end.speech_stuck: Speech output got stuck, so the conversation stopped.

section.title: Conversation
section.description: Hands-free conversation: Vox listens, answers aloud, and keeps a short memory of this session.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong with the conversation.

section.silenceDescription: How long Vox waits in silence before it treats your turn as finished.
section.idleTurnsDescription: Vox stops the conversation after this many turns in a row with no speech.
section.contextTurnsDescription: How many recent exchanges are sent to the reply backend. Older turns are dropped and the memory expires with the session.
section.shortcutDescription: Change this in the shortcut settings. Shown here for reference.
section.privacyNote: What you say and Vox's replies are sent to your configured reply backend.
section.wakeWordNote: Mendengarkan sekitar harus dimatikan saat percakapan berjalan. Kata pemicu juga harus dimatikan, kecuali tindakannya diatur ke bicara dengan asisten.

bargeIn.label: Interupsi dengan berbicara
bargeIn.description: Bicaralah di atas asisten untuk menghentikannya. Gunakan headphone: lewat speaker, asisten akan mendengar suaranya sendiri. Suara Phonon dan Natural juga akan mengecil saat Anda berbicara; suara sistem hanya dihentikan. Memerlukan balasan suara yang aktif.

voice.title: Fitur suara
voice.intro: Add-on opsional untuk percakapan tanpa tangan. Setiap add-on mati sampai Anda menyalakannya, dan setiap unduhan hanya terjadi saat Anda menekan Unduh.

error.corrupt: Berkas yang diunduh tidak sesuai dengan ukuran atau checksum yang diharapkan. Unduh lagi.
error.url_not_allowed: Alamat unduhan tidak ada dalam daftar yang diizinkan.
error.download: Unduhan gagal. Periksa koneksi Anda lalu coba lagi.
error.io: Berkas tidak dapat disimpan di komputer ini.

smartTurn.heading: Deteksi giliran pintar
smartTurn.label: Deteksi giliran pintar
smartTurn.description: Menggunakan model kecil untuk memutuskan kapan Anda selesai berbicara, sehingga Vox bisa membalas lebih cepat. Audio disimpan di memori selama satu giliran dan tidak disimpan.
smartTurn.fallbackNote: Model belum terpasang, jadi Vox menggunakan aturan jeda tetap.
smartTurn.modelDescription: Unduhan sekali saja sekitar {{size}}. Model berjalan di komputer ini.
smartTurn.modelDescriptionPending: Unduhan sekali saja. Model berjalan di komputer ini.

latency.heading: Panel latensi
latency.label: Tampilkan panel latensi
latency.description: Menampilkan angka waktu untuk setiap giliran dalam percakapan. Hanya angka: tidak ada audio atau teks yang disimpan.
latency.samples: Median dan persentil ke-90 dari {{count}} giliran terakhir.

persona.heading: Persona
persona.label: Persona
persona.description: Pengaturan siap pakai untuk gaya balasan dan suara. Menerapkan persona akan mengatur keduanya sekaligus.

error.limit_reached: Anda dapat menyimpan hingga {{max}} persona kustom. Hapus salah satu untuk menambah yang baru.
error.generic: Persona tidak dapat disimpan. Coba lagi.

speaker.heading: Filter pembicara
speaker.label: Filter pembicara
speaker.description: Abaikan ucapan yang tidak terdengar seperti suara Anda yang sudah terdaftar.

disclosure.lead: Filter pembicara adalah filter kenyamanan. Ini bukan keamanan dan bukan autentikasi.
disclosure.detail: Filter ini bisa keliru mengabaikan suara Anda sendiri, dan rekaman atau suara yang mirip bisa lolos. Voiceprint Anda tetap ada di komputer ini, dalam berkas yang hanya bisa dibaca oleh akun Anda. Tidak ada audio yang disimpan. Filter ini mati secara default.

speaker.inactiveNote: Filter tetap tidak aktif sampai model pembicara terpasang dan suara Anda sudah terdaftar.
speaker.sensitivityDescription: Seberapa ketat ucapan dari suara lain disaring.

sensitivity.lenientHint: Membiarkan lebih banyak suara lewat, dan lebih jarang keliru mengabaikan Anda.
sensitivity.balancedHint: Pengaturan default, jalan tengah di antara keduanya.
sensitivity.strictHint: Menyaring lebih banyak suara lain, dan lebih sering keliru mengabaikan Anda.

speaker.modelDescription: Unduhan sekali saja sekitar {{size}}. Model berjalan di komputer ini.

enroll.label: Daftarkan suara Anda
enroll.description: Tiga rekaman pendek masing-masing sekitar 6 detik. Bicaralah seperti biasa di tempat yang tenang.
enroll.intro: Anda akan membaca tiga kelompok kalimat pendek. Hanya voiceprint yang disimpan, audio tidak pernah disimpan.
enroll.readThese: Bacakan kalimat-kalimat ini dengan suara biasa Anda:
enroll.allRecorded: Ketiga rekaman sudah masuk. Selesaikan untuk menyimpan voiceprint Anda.

messages.busy: Hentikan percakapan atau dikte terlebih dahulu.
messages.too_little_speech: Bicaralah sedikit lebih lama. Vox memerlukan setidaknya 2 detik ucapan untuk setiap rekaman.
messages.inconsistent: Ketiga rekaman tidak terdengar mirip. Mulai lagi dari rekaman pertama.
messages.session_ended: Pendaftaran telah berakhir. Mulai lagi saat Anda siap.

prompts.s1a: Rubah cokelat yang cepat melompati anjing yang malas.
prompts.s1b: Tolong buka kalender saya dan beri tahu apa agenda hari ini.
prompts.s2b: Beri tahu saya satu fakta singkat tentang bulan.
prompts.s2c: Saya ingin secangkir teh di dekat jendela.
prompts.s3a: Ingatkan saya untuk menelepon adik perempuan saya besok pagi.
prompts.s3b: Bacakan pesan terbaru dari tim saya.
prompts.s3c: Terima kasih, itu saja untuk sekarang.

speaker.deleteDescription: Menghapus voiceprint yang tersimpan. Tanpa voiceprint, filter pembicara tidak bisa berjalan.
speaker.deleteConfirm: Hapus voiceprint? Anda perlu mendaftar lagi untuk menggunakan filter.
speaker.deleteError: Voiceprint tidak dapat dihapus. Coba lagi.

chat.title: Vox Conversation
chat.empty: No conversation yet. Type a message below, or say your wake phrase.
chat.footerHint: Type a message, or say your wake phrase or press your conversation shortcut.

sendError.not_configured: Set up a reply model in Settings first.
sendError.busy: Vox is busy. Try again in a moment.

chat.clearFailed: Could not clear the conversation. Try again.
chat.subtitle: Conversation

system.dropped: {{count}} lines were skipped while the window was busy.

end.idle: Stopped after no speech for several turns.
end.not_configured: Spoken replies are not set up. Turn on spoken replies and choose a reply backend.
end.speech_stuck: Speech output got stuck, so the conversation stopped.

orb.label: Vox orb. Press Enter to open the conversation.
